hero.heading: Treatments & Pricing
hero.lead_before: Facials, lashes, brows, waxing, and back treatments in Idaho Falls, all personalized to your skin. A
hero.lead_after: deposit holds your spot and goes toward your service.

facials.heading: Facials
facials.body: Customized, results-driven facials that still feel like a treat.

lashes.heading: Lashes
lashes.body: Wake up with lifted, darker lashes. No extensions, no daily curling.

brows.heading: Brows
brows.body: Fuller, styled brows that hold their shape for weeks.

waxing.heading: Waxing
waxing.body: Quick, gentle facial and underarm waxing with soothing aftercare.

back.heading: Back Treatments
back.body: A facial for your back. Deep cleansing, exfoliation, and warm stone relaxation.

led.heading: LED Light Therapy
led.body: Calming light therapy that supports clear, healthy-looking skin. Add it to any facial.

addons.heading: Add-ons
addons.body: Small upgrades that make a good facial even better.
